environment.description: Service deployed on ECS Fargate in isolated VPC subnet (no IGW, no NAT). Accessible exclusively through com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0a4b8c9d2e1f3a5b7 interface endpoint. VPC endpoint policy restricts Principal to arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/internal-doc-processor-role and arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/dashboard-readonly-role. Subnet route table has no 0.0.0.0/0 route. Security group sg-0abc123def456 on the ECS tasks allows inbound only from sg-0fed654cba321 (the VPC endpoint ENI security group). DNS resolution for the service uses private hosted zone doc-svc.internal.corp that resolves only within the VPC. No public DNS record exists for this service.

config.dns: private hosted zone, no public record
